title: Perioperative video education for patients before bariatric surgeries
summary: This study examines overall patient satisfaction prior to bariatric surgery and the potential for improving it. Patients are divided into two groups: one group is shown a video explaining the surgery and postoperative care before the preoperative consultation, while the other group receives only the consultation. Immediately following the consultation, patient satisfaction is assessed using a questionnaire. Immediately before the surgery, the surgeon assesses anxiety using the NRS. During the follow-up consultation two weeks after the surgery, overall satisfaction is then evaluated using a questionnaire as well.
